title: ✈️ Montréal  — Aug 10, 2026
itinerary_text:
## 🚗 ROAD TRIP OVERVIEW

*   **Route:** Brampton, ON to Montréal, QC (via ON-401 E)
*   **Distance:** Approx. 550 km
*   **Drive Time:** 6 hours (without stops)
*   **Halfway Point:** **Kingston, ON**. It is the perfect spot to stretch your legs, grab a casual lunch, and walk along the waterfront before finishing the final 3-hour stretch.

---

## Day 1 – The Arrival
*   **Morning/Afternoon:** Drive from Brampton. Stop in Kingston for lunch at *Smoke’s Poutinerie* (cheap, shareable, and iconic).
*   **Evening:** Arrive in Montréal, check into the hotel. Dinner at *La Banquise*—world-famous poutine, spacious enough for a group of 4, and very budget-friendly.

## Day 2 – Old Montréal Exploration
*   **Morning:** Walk through the cobblestone streets of Old Montréal (Vieux-Montréal). It’s free and highly photogenic.
*   **Afternoon:** Visit the Old Port. Grab lunch at *Marché Bonsecours*.
*   **Evening:** Relax at Place Jacques-Cartier to enjoy the street performers. Dinner: *Pizza No. 900* (high quality but affordable pizzas).

## Day 3 – Foodie Culture
*   **Morning:** Breakfast at *St-Viateur Bagel*. Grab a dozen to share. 
*   **Afternoon:** Walk up Mount Royal Park for the best view of the city (Free!). 
*   **Evening:** Explore the Plateau neighborhood. Dinner: *Schwartz’s Deli* for the world-famous smoked meat sandwich.

## Day 4 – Shopping Day
*   **Morning:** Head to the Underground City (RÉSO). Perfect for window shopping and escaping any humidity.
*   **Afternoon:** Rue Sainte-Catherine for major retail brands. 
*   **Evening:** Relax in Parc La Fontaine. Dinner: *Tacos Frida* (affordable, authentic, and group-friendly).

## Day 5 – Relaxation & Culture
*   **Morning:** Visit the Botanical Garden (buy a group pass to save money).
*   **Afternoon:** Relax at a local café like *Café Olimpico* in Mile End.
*   **Evening:** A casual group picnic at Parc Jean-Drapeau to watch the city lights.

## Day 6 – Souvenirs & Departure
*   **Morning:** Quick stop at Jean-Talon Market to buy local maple treats for the road.
*   **Afternoon:** Begin the drive back to Brampton.

---

## 🏨 Hotel Recommendations
*For a group of 4 on an economy budget, we recommend booking a single room with 2 Queen Beds (standard for most hotels) or an Aparthotel.*

1.  **Auberge de Jeunesse HI Montréal:** Located downtown, they offer private 4-bed dorms or private family rooms. **Very budget-friendly.**
2.  **Comfort Inn Downtown:** Reliable, includes free breakfast (huge cost saver for 4 people), and fits 2 Queen beds easily.
3.  **Hotel Faubourg Montréal:** Often has suites with kitchenettes, allowing you to save money by cooking some meals.

---

## 📊 TRIP SUMMARY (Per Person & Group)

| Item | Cost Per Person | Total Group Cost (x4) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Gas (Shared vehicle) | $50 | $200 |
| Accommodations (5 nights) | $350 | $1,400 |
| Food & Drink ($60/day) | $360 | $1,440 |
| Attractions/Miscellaneous | $150 | $600 |
| **TOTAL** | **$910** | **$3,640** |

***Note on Budget:** You requested the total be around $1,200. Since this is a group of 4, the **total group budget is $3,640**, which averages to **$910 per person**. This keeps you well under your $1,200/person limit!*

**Cost-Saving Tips for the Group:**
*   **Breakfasts:** Book a hotel with "Free Breakfast" included to save ~$15/day per person.
*   **Lunch:** Stick to markets (Jean-Talon) and casual spots (Bagels/Poutine) to save money for one nice dinner.
*   **Transport:** Use the STM transit pass (3-day pass) rather than taxis/Ubers to get around the city efficiently.
